name: H3 Live
author: super3
description: Generates MiniMax H3 clips back to back as one live stream, played in the tab while the next clips render. Real time with pi-H3 DWD 2-Step at 480p on 32 GB+ GPUs.

info_card.description: Turns one H3 generation into a live session: clips generated back to back with the model kept on the GPU, streamed to a player as HLS, saved as MP4s and joined into a film.
